artworks.title: The Marriage of Ferdinando and Christine of Lorraine
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.2 × 27.5 cm (8 3/4 × 10 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a group of people in a formal setting. In the center, a man and a woman seem to be exchanging something. The woman wears an ornate gown with patterns, a high collar, and a crown or a similar headpiece. Her hair is styled up and adorned with jewelry. The man, facing her, wears a detailed outfit with a cape, a tunic, and breeches. He has a beard and carries a sword. Surrounding them are attendants and onlookers, both men and women, in period clothing with ruffled collars and headdresses. Some individuals wear capes and hold specific hand gestures. A man in a clerical hat stands behind the woman. The background emphasizes the grandeur of the gathering.

artworks.title: The Defeat of the Turkish Cavalry
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22 × 29.4 cm (8 11/16 × 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The image shows a detailed depiction of a battle scene in a monochrome palette. The foreground features an armored figure on horseback, wielding a weapon. The horse is captured mid-motion, with fallen figures and horses around them. In the background, there is an ongoing clash between two armies, with soldiers on foot and on horseback, brandishing spears and shields. A cityscape or fortress is faintly visible in the distance, with smoke rising.

artworks.title: The First Naval Battle
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.8 × 30.5 cm (9 × 12 in.)
artworks.description: This engraving depicts a naval battle with numerous ships engaged in combat. The scene shows two large galleys locked in combat, with figures battling on their decks. The ships are decorated with flags and banners. Smoke suggests cannon fire and skirmishes. The detailed lines capture the sea, rigging, and architecture of the ships. The image is monochromatic, emphasizing the intricate details and the expansive scene of the battle.

artworks.title: Floats and Participants
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.4 × 30.1 cm (8 13/16 × 11 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of ornate carriages and figures. It includes elaborately decorated carriages pulled by animals, accompanied by various figures in period costumes holding weapons or musical instruments. Each carriage has distinct, intricate designs and is labeled with titles suggestive of different regions or mythological themes, such as "Carro, dell' Africa" or "Carro, di Marte e Venere." Below, various figures appear on horseback or standing, each labeled with descriptions likely naming their roles or origins. The overall composition is detailed and formal, reminiscent of processional illustrations, showing a clear fascination with theatrical and ceremonial elements.

artworks.title: Parade in the Amphitheater
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 × 30.3 cm (8 15/16 × 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large event in an arena. The central area features groups of figures on horseback and on foot, engaged in activities. Around them is a crowd, enclosed by barriers, with buildings in the background. The scene is lively with detailed linework showing various actions and poses, creating a historical and festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: One of the Infantry Combats
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 22.7 x 30.3 cm (8 15/16 x 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large, organized event taking place in an enclosed circular area surrounded by buildings and spectators. The scene features numerous figures positioned in an open central space, divided into formations or groups. The drawing is detailed, with a multitude of people depicted, each in various poses and activities. There are people on horseback in the central area. Around the circle, stands are filled with spectators watching the event. The architecture surrounding the scene is densely packed, with intricate windows and rooftops visible. The image captures the atmosphere of a grand occasion, possibly a festivity or public gathering, filled with motion and excitement.

artworks.title: Two Zanni
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various creatures in a lively scene. Two large, monstrous figures with exaggerated facial features and limbs stand in dynamic poses facing each other. They possess horns and are wearing ragged clothing. Smaller, human-like characters in elaborate attire are engaged in activities around them, giving the scene an air of festivity or performance. The central figures appear animated and the smaller characters seem part of a bustling gathering. The background features trees and open space, suggesting an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: The Float of Mount Parnassus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.1 × 22.7 cm (5 15/16 × 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a group of figures in a procession. Closest to the viewer is a group of elaborately dressed figures, led by a banner-holder. The scene extends from left to right with a rocky outcrop guiding the eyes across the composition. Additional figures and a horse with a rider are seen further along a rocky path leading upward. The intricate details and textures of the landscape and figures are created using fine, detailed brushstrokes characteristic of engraving. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a light beige background, emphasizing the detailed line work and contrast.

artworks.title: The Float of Thetis
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 22.8 cm (5 7/8 × 9 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical sea-themed procession. The image depicts an elaborate mythical parade. Central to the arrangement is a large, ornate chariot dominated by a layered structure draped with seaweed-like foliage, which is pulled by a large creature resembling a sea monster. Scattered around the chariot are figures with aquatic features, wielding tridents, and appearing as though emerging from the sea itself. Complementing them are additional sea creatures and figures intricately drawn. The banner near the top right corner of the image contains text in Italian.

artworks.title: The Float of the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 22.7 cm (5 7/8 × 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand symbolic procession. The image depicts various figures including a central figure carrying a large sphere on his shoulders, surrounded by elaborately dressed individuals, mythical beings, and horses pulling a chariot. The drawing is intricately detailed, with the figures arranged in a dynamic composition that suggests movement. Clothing and ornamentation reflect a mixture of historical styles, with emphasis on elaborate headpieces and flowing garments. The upper portion includes an inscription.

artworks.title: The Float of Love
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 22.8 cm (5 7/8 × 9 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures amid clouds with a scroll of text. In the middle section are a group of winged figures holding bows and arrows, arranged in a scattered pattern. Below them are three figures who appear to be holding hands and appear to be in a dance. On the upper left is a scroll with Italian text set against the blank background. The clouds, figures, and scroll are rendered with intricate line work.

artworks.title: View of the Festival
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.7 × 29.9 cm (8 15/16 × 11 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an oval-shaped arena filled with horses and riders, surrounded by a crowd of onlookers on a platform and nearby buildings. There are figures engaged in a performance or procession, some on horseback and others on foot, wielding props or instruments. The scene is detailed with ornate buildings, suggesting a historical or culturally significant setting. The drawing has detailed line work and captures the energy and complexity of the scene from an elevated perspective.

artworks.title: First Intermezzo
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a theatrical scene in a grand hall. The stage features a group of people in period attire engaged in a choreographed performance. The stage is elevated, with a backdrop of trees. The hall is richly decorated, with architectural and fabric details. The ceiling is detailed, and the seating areas are filled with an audience. The drawing is in a detailed, monochrome linear style, capturing the complexity of the scene and the movement of the figures.

artworks.title: Second Intermezzo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.4 × 28.9 cm (8 1/16 × 11 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The image features tall ruins with columns and arches. Small mythical creatures are scattered around a central figure. There are towers with decorative elements in the background. Figures are scaling the structures. The style is creative and whimsical.

artworks.title: Third Intermezzo
artworks.description: The image shows a grand classical architectural setting with a celestial scene above. The drawing features a large gathering of people in extravagant attire, in a cityscape with columns, arches, and buildings. Above, figures and creatures are seen riding through clouds. The scene is framed by a decorative curtain at the top, adding a theatrical quality. The architectural elements and procession give the drawing an elaborate and celebratory atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Garden
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic, rural landscape. A wooden structure with a thatched roof and a cow beneath it is on the left. Two figures are engaged in chores, with a sheep nearby. In the center, stone and wooden buildings are surrounded by trees. To the right, a wooden structure with a rustic roof and a wagon wheel is near two figures in an open field. Fine lines create texture and depth, with a monochromatic palette providing a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: The Dovecot
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.6 × 22 cm (3 3/8 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is defined by trees and buildings in the distance. In the center, there is a round structure with a conical roof, a man with a stick, and a dog. To the right, some goats or sheep are on a path, leading to a village with buildings and trees. The artwork uses fine lines to show textures and shadows, creating a sense of depth. The color palette is monochromatic, contrasting dark ink strokes with a light background.

artworks.title: The Watermill
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.8 × 22.1 cm (3 7/16 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with architectural and natural elements. The view is from a slight angle, looking across a body of water towards a large building with an arched opening. Various structures line the water's edge along with trees. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, emphasizing textures of stone, water, and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white shades for contrast and depth. People are engaged near the water, with one person bathing and others near the building. In the distance, smaller boats are seen on the water, and a variety of buildings and trees lead to a soft skyline.

artworks.title: The Small Port
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 8.5 × 22 cm (3 3/8 × 8 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts activities on land and on the water. The horizon line is low, showing a city skyline across the water with buildings, including domes and towers. Closest to us on the right are detailed, aged buildings with stairs and trees. The style features detailed brushstrokes in an etching technique, emphasizing lines and shading for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of black and brown on a cream background. Boats on the left and figures on the shoreline add to the busy atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Walk by the Water
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.6 × 25 cm (4 9/16 × 9 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a riverside scene. A rustic building with detailed brickwork and tile roofing is on the right. People are near the river, engaging in various activities. An animal grazes near a resting man, while individuals converse near small boats by the shore. The landscape features a river, boats, and distant hills. The etched lines provide texture to the trees, buildings, and water. The color palette is monochromatic, creating a serene depiction.

artworks.title: Loading Merchandise
artworks.description: The image depicts architectural features along a coast. A building with detailed stonework and arches is on the left side. In the foreground, there are people, a cart, and a horse. Boats are docked near people by the water. In the background are hills with scattered buildings, including towers and homes. The style of the drawing is intricate, resembling etching, in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: The Bathers
artworks.description: The image shows a view slightly above the water. The horizon is low, showcasing architectural and natural elements. There is a large building with arches on the right side, next to a tall tree. The brushwork is detailed, defining textures and clouds. In the distance, a cityscape is visible. The color palette is monochrome. Close to the viewer, there are figures and a boat on the water. Along the shore, more people are engaged in activities.

artworks.title: The Stag Hunt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.7 × 25.1 cm (4 5/8 × 9 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from an elevated position, featuring a countryside scene with houses, trees, foliage, and a hunting scene with people, horses, and dogs. Hills in the distance show more trees and a faint outline of a church steeple. The artist uses fine line engravings to create texture, with a monochromatic color palette typical of a traditional etching.

artworks.title: Hunting Birds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.8 × 25.1 cm (4 5/8 × 9 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slight elevation. Rolling hills with trees and small structures are depicted, leading towards the right side. The artwork emphasizes line work to define the landscape, with precise strokes creating texture and dimension. Small figures, animals, and a building are dispersed throughout the scene. The color palette is predominantly cream shades with dark lines, characteristic of an etching, highlighting intricate details and tonal contrast.
